body.p: . src/xpath_static_internal.h (module xpath_static): sxml_xpath_static_context (heap, allocator, namespace bindings, variable declarations, function table); sxml_xpath_resolve_name, _resolve_sequence_type and _resolve_item_type (also for the type text of function library rows, ); sxml_xpath_lower (AST to an unsealed unit) and sxml_xpath_compile (parse, lower, sxml_ir_standard_passes, seal), which 1.23 calls.

item.p: Names: the AST's namespace declarations, then the configuration, then the predeclared prefixes; unprefixed functions are in fn, variables, attributes and QName literals in no namespace, element and type names in the default element namespace. Function names are found with sxml_name_pool_find_name: a name never interned is XPST0017. Global variable n is variable declaration n, referenced or not, so the processor binds by index.

Shape: ANF blocks append LETs; atoms (literals, variables) are never bound. Left-recursive chains (binary operators, paths, filters, lookups, dynamic calls, arrows) are walked in a loop; other nesting costs one frame of the lowering machine in allocator memory (; no C recursion), bounded by maximum_expression_depth (default SXML_XPATH_DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_EXPRESSION_DEPTH, 10,000 levels, a few MB of frames at most; LIMIT_EXCEEDED beyond). The former default of 32 for the WebAssembly stack is gone. An inline function's free variables are found by walking its AST through parent links; each becomes a captured slot, except a constant (a let of a literal), which is substituted. Globals read in a function are captured ().
Focus: slots made on first read (main, MAP, FILTER); absent in an inline function body (a RAISE of XPDY0002 where read); a focus function and -> fix the value, with position and size 1.

Paths: E1/E2 is MAP then DOCUMENT_ORDER; // adds a MAP of descendant-or-self::node() and DOCUMENT_ORDER; a reverse-axis step is followed by DOCUMENT_ORDER after its predicates; default axis attribute or namespace for those tests; node() steps use the generic node type. A name test on a JNode origin is the evaluator's to read as a key test (XPath 4.0, 4.6.5), since STEP carries element(N).

Calls: COERCE unless the type is item()* or a constant already matches; constructor functions are CAST allowing empty; a left-out context-value parameter is the focus value (static calls) or captured by a closure (f#N); position()/last() read focus slots; static placeholders make a closure (constant arguments in its body, others coerced and captured); dynamic placeholders call fn:partial-apply with xs:positiveInteger keys; keyword arguments are reordered; and/or are CONDITIONALs giving true()/false(), otherwise tests instance of item()+, string templates use fn:string-join#2 and ||. fn:root, fn:partial-apply and fn:string-join must be in the table.
Literals: integers inline or as decimal cells (hex and binary converted); doubles through decimal text, rounded once ().

Not lowered in Phase 1 (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, diagnostic filled): for member, for key/value, destructuring let, method calls, but with, dynamic node tests, the item axis, named namespace-axis tests (P4), jnode() selectors other than *, (), NCName, string, integer, boolean.
Text form: nested expression operands start a line two columns past their parent's "(", except a LET's bound expression; constants print as XPath literals (doubles as <shortest decimal>e0).
Checks: with a permissive function table, 29,653 of the 32,409 valid XP40 queries lower and pass the verifier; the rest are static errors from missing test environments, or the constructs above.
sxml_native_function now has properties after function_namespace (no padding; clang-tidy's padding check failed on the first file to include it). Field order only.
sxml_function_table_find () is declared but nobody defines it yet; static analysis uses sxml_xpath_find_function; 1.20 may define the wrapper over it.
